blocks.orig: Prison Island was once built to condemn Zanzibari citizens to isolation on the island. These days it’s home to a tortoise sanctuary and a hotel. It lies at a 20-minute boat ride from Zanzibar’s capital Stone Town and once here, you find giant tortoises shuﬄe through the trees (some of whom are estimated to be over 100 years old!). On the island, you can visit the sanctuary, follow some hiking trails, or swim in the crystal clear waters surrounding the island.
blocks.html: Prison Island was originally built to keep Zanzibari citizens in isolation on the island. Nowadays it’s home to a tortoise sanctuary and a hotel. The island is a 20-minute boat trip from Zanzibar’s capital Stone Town, and here you see giant tortoises shuffling between the trees (some are thought to be more than 100 years old!). While on the island, you can visit the sanctuary, walk along the hiking trails, or swim in the crystal clear water around the island.
